title: How long can the studio last
brief: I never know how many months our small studio can keep operating at current spend without staring at a spreadsheet.

target_population.role: founder of a fictional three-person design studio watching monthly burn
target_population.coverage_limit: one fictional studio scenario at a time; no real accounts or historical books

core_task.summary: enter cash on hand and monthly burn, then read the runway projection
core_task.success_oracle: entering cash 84000 and burn 7000 renders a twelve-month runway bar whose exhaustion month is labelled 2027-08

not_applicable_states.loading: the projection is pure arithmetic over two local inputs recomputed synchronously, so there is never an in-flight computation to display

state_recipes.empty: clear both inputs on first run; the scenario panel explains what to enter before any bar renders
state_recipes.validation-error: enter a negative or non-numeric monthly burn; an inline error names the field and no projection updates
state_recipes.success: enter cash 84000 and burn 7000; the runway bar renders twelve months ending 2027-08
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the cash-on-hand input shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the dashboard at 390x844; the runway bar wraps into a stacked month grid

acceptance_facts: The seeded example scenario uses fictional cash of 84000 and burn of 7000, producing a twelve-month runway ending 2027-08.
Changing the burn input recomputes the runway length and exhaustion label within the same interaction.
A visible disclaimer marks every projection as fictional decision support and not financial advice.

product_signature.mechanism: runway bar that converts two inputs into a labelled exhaustion month
product_signature.anchor: runway bar spanning the dashboard header
product_signature.brief_trace: how many months our small studio can keep operating at current spend
product_signature.counterfactual: a generic ledger table would fit a bookkeeping brief and never answers how long the studio can last
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the bar counting twelve months to the 2027-08 exhaustion label

anti_goals: no bank connections, imports, or real transaction data
no investment, fundraising, or financial advice of any kind
no multi-scenario portfolio modelling beyond one scenario at a time

content_seed.data_notes: the studio, balances, and expense lines are invented for illustration; no real business figures may seed the product

safety.disclaimer_required: Uses fictional data; illustrative decision support for thinking about spend only — not financial advice, accounting, or a forecast of any real business.
